low_stock.title: Low Stock Alerts
low_stock.subtitle: View components that are running low on stock.
low_stock.help_p1: Low Stock Alerts highlight components whose quantity has fallen below the defined minimum stock level.
low_stock.help_p2: This helps you notice parts that may soon run out, so you can restock them before they become unavailable during work.
low_stock.help_p3: Alerts are informational only — they do not block usage or trigger automatic actions.
low_stock.help_p4: Minimum stock values are defined per component and can be adjusted at any time.
low_stock.warning: These components need immediate restocking attention.
